language: English + Sinhala-script + conservative Singlish starter (v0.2 amendment, 24 October 2026; Tamil unsupported)
purpose: Original synthetic scenarios, not source-verified incidents. Forty pairs reuse the later bake-off planning target, not an institutional interim minimum or executed evaluation. The twelve v0.2 pairs (M4-SL01-SL12) are synthetic adaptations of the Sri Lankan scam-landscape patterns recorded in evidence/M4-scam-landscape-sri-lanka-20261024.md; no real message text is copied into this file.
interpretation: scenario_group is a sampling bucket, not actual model category/verdict. Rule references are hypotheses to probe, including false positives. Controls do not prove safety. No destination may be fetched. All entities are fictional and .example supplies no reputation evidence. R-M4-18/19 shape-flag pairs quote fabricated short-link and abuse-TLD host spellings for shape testing only; hosts are fictional, never fetched, and no reputation inference is made. Result schema and Unicode span units/normalization remain open.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Both discuss imminent account suspension; control avoids message-link credential collection and directs independent access, which must still not be treated as authenticated sender proof.

messages.text: Your bank account will be suspended in 30 minutes. Verify your password at https://account-verify.example/restore to keep access.
expected_findings: Pressure plus password request at an unverified message destination; not proven malicious reputation.
messages.span_convention: ASCII zero-based end-exclusive; not a Unicode runtime decision

messages.text: Your bank account review is due in 30 minutes. Do not send your password. Open the banking app you already use to check whether any action is needed; this message cannot verify your account status.
expected_findings: Do not overflag the deadline or negated password warning as credential solicitation; independent verification remains appropriate.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same login alert/code vocabulary; disclosure request is replaced by a warning and independent review.

messages.text: Harborleaf Bank login alert: reply with the one-time code from your phone so our agent can cancel this login. Keep this verification chat open.
expected_findings: Request to disclose a one-time code; bank identity is unverified.

messages.text: Harborleaf Bank login alert: never reply with a one-time code from your phone. Review this login in the banking app you already installed, or use your independently saved bank contact.
expected_findings: Code mention is a prohibition, not collection; do not infer a confirmed phishing incident from it.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Both are campus portal maintenance notices with a URL; control does not request credentials through the message.

messages.text: Moonreed Campus portal maintenance: enter your student password at https://moonreed-help.example/check to prevent your timetable account being disabled tonight.
expected_findings: Password collection at an unverified maintenance destination with a disabling threat.

messages.text: Moonreed Campus portal maintenance tonight: read the public schedule at https://moonreed-help.example/check. Do not enter a password there; use your independently bookmarked campus portal to review your timetable.
expected_findings: URL and password warning alone are insufficient for phishing; no reputation or safety conclusion from .example.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same LKR refund context; control removes the bank-login collection, not merely the refund keyword.

messages.text: Cloudfern Utilities refund: LKR 2400 is waiting. Confirm your bank login and password at https://cloudfern-refund.example/claim before we cancel the credit.
expected_findings: Refund pretext solicits bank credentials via a supplied destination.

messages.text: Cloudfern Utilities refund: LKR 2400 is listed as a credit on your next statement. We do not need your bank login or password. Check your bill through the account channel you normally use.
expected_findings: Refund/credential vocabulary is not a request to disclose secrets; verify independently without declaring sender authenticated.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Both use the same short-looking URL; differing request context matters and plain text supplies no display-target mismatch.

messages.text: Fernpost parcel held in Kandy. Unlock delivery by entering your card PIN at https://go.fernpost.example/x. Our driver cannot wait.
expected_findings: Delivery pretext requests card PIN; URL is unverified, not established as a known shortener or display-target mismatch.

messages.text: Fernpost parcel held in Kandy. Delivery hours are listed at https://go.fernpost.example/x. No card PIN or payment is needed; confirm your booking using the receipt contact you already hold.
expected_findings: Do not equate compact URL shape or a negated PIN warning with fraud; no fetching or invented target.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same workplace password reset context; control tells recipient to use the existing workflow rather than send a password.

messages.text: Windpetal Studio IT desk: send your current email password to support@windpetal-reset.example so we can complete your mailbox reset before lunch.
expected_findings: Direct password disclosure to an unverified email; extracted email is only a candidate.

messages.text: Windpetal Studio IT desk: do not send your current email password to support@windpetal-reset.example or any agent. Complete a mailbox reset through the helpdesk workflow you already use.
expected_findings: Negated password solicitation must not become a matched credential request; email presence is not incident evidence.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same nested host; control cautions about it. Host nesting alone cannot prove impersonation or a threshold match.

messages.text: Harborleaf Bank secure review: enter your banking password at https://harborleaf.bank.review.example/login to avoid losing mobile access today.
expected_findings: Password request and threat; nested host can be inspected as text, but no trusted-domain comparison or excessive-depth threshold is approved.

messages.text: Harborleaf Bank awareness exercise: https://harborleaf.bank.review.example/login is an unverified example, not a place to enter your password. Use your existing banking app to review access notices.
expected_findings: Quoted training URL and negation are not active credential solicitation; do not click or assume sender legitimacy.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Both mention an account lock, deadline and password; only suspicious variant requests disclosure in a reply.

messages.text: Reedlight Co-op account locked: reply with your password before 4 pm so the service desk can restore access. Do not visit the branch; this reply is the only recovery route.
expected_findings: Password reply plus pressure and discouraging independent checks.

messages.text: Reedlight Co-op account locked: the service desk closes at 4 pm. Never reply with your password. Use the branch or the recovery route listed on your existing membership paperwork.
expected_findings: Office deadline and password warning must not be overflagged as disclosure demand; status itself remains unverified.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Both discuss affection and travel to Colombo; control retains relationship topic without remote-person transfer demand.

messages.text: My love, although we have never met, send LKR 48000 for my flight to Colombo today. I cannot video call or let you speak to the travel agent; trust our relationship.
expected_findings: Asserted online romance, money request and blocked verification suggest manipulation, not a confirmed incident.

messages.text: My love, I checked the LKR 48000 flight to Colombo for our trip. We can compare bookings together when we meet; do not transfer money to anyone from this message.
expected_findings: Affection, airfare and money mention without a transfer demand must not alone imply romance fraud.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same partner medical-emergency discussion; control requests practical contact/verification rather than an unverified payment.

messages.text: Darling, my emergency surgery cannot wait. We have only chatted online, but please send LKR 35000 to the agent I name now. Do not call the hospital or tell your family.
expected_findings: Romantic trust leveraged for urgent medical money while preventing independent checks.

messages.text: Darling, we discussed the possible LKR 35000 surgery bill. Please call the hospital through its independently listed number with my family before deciding anything; I am not asking for a transfer in this chat.
expected_findings: Medical and relationship vocabulary with independent verification is not by itself romance-scam evidence.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same long-distance romance and visa topic; remove urgent fee-to-stranger request.

messages.text: Our online romance is real. Pay my visa release fee to this new agent today so I can finally meet you in Galle. The embassy cannot discuss it; only your trust can help.
expected_findings: Romance pretext plus visa payment demand and discouraged verification.

messages.text: Our long-distance plans to meet in Galle need a visa review. I will confirm any fees directly through official channels myself; please do not pay an agent because of our online chat.
expected_findings: Visa/romance alone does not establish a scam; negated agent payment should not be inverted.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Both mention a partner and gift card; control declines disclosure instead of demanding card codes.

messages.text: Sweetheart, I am still working overseas and cannot meet. Buy a gift card and send its redemption code to prove you care. Keep this between us until my leave is approved.
expected_findings: Emotional pressure, no meeting and gift-card code demand suggest romance manipulation.

messages.text: Sweetheart, thank you for thinking about a gift card while I work overseas. Do not send a redemption code in chat; let us choose a present together when my leave is approved.
expected_findings: Ordinary gift discussion with code-sharing warning is not a demanded gift-card payment.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same online relationship and investment topic; control cautions against funding an unverified investment.

messages.text: I know we have only dated online, but our future needs this crypto investment. Transfer LKR 25000 to my broker today; do not ask anyone else because they will not understand our love.
expected_findings: Romantic leverage for an unverified investment transfer and isolation; category remains distinct from verdict.

messages.text: We have only dated online, so do not transfer LKR 25000 to any broker because of our relationship. Discuss any crypto investment independently with someone you trust before deciding.
expected_findings: Warning about romance-linked investing must not be classified solely from crypto, love or amount keywords.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Both discuss romantic plans and a work-related fee; control does not seek money or block verification.

messages.text: Dearest, my overseas work contract traps me here. Send LKR 18000 to release my leave so we can meet for the first time. My employer forbids calls, so please pay without checking.
expected_findings: First-meeting promise plus release-fee demand and blocked verification.

messages.text: Dearest, my overseas work leave is still under review before our visit. I will resolve the LKR 18000 contract question directly with my employer; do not send money on my behalf from this chat.
expected_findings: Overseas work and romantic plans are not enough to infer a fraud demand.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same relationship and family emergency topic; control retains urgency but asks for verified contact rather than secret payment.

messages.text: My love, my brother needs urgent treatment. Although you have never met either of us, send money to my new wallet now. Do not speak to your family; this will test your loyalty.
expected_findings: Loyalty pressure and secret wallet transfer linked to an unverified online relationship.

messages.text: My love, my brother needs urgent treatment. Please speak to our families and confirm the hospital contact independently; do not send money to a new wallet on the strength of this message.
expected_findings: Urgency/affection retained without transfer solicitation; verification context must affect interpretation.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Both discuss meeting and ticket costs; genuine-looking control includes ordinary shared expenses, not a blanket money ban.

messages.text: We will finally meet after months of online dating if you wire my ticket money today. I cannot show a booking or join a call. If you love me, do not question the agent.
expected_findings: Unverified travel transfer with emotional coercion and refusal of checks.

messages.text: For our next visit after last month's meeting, shall we split ticket costs as usual? Let us review the booking together on a call before either of us pays the travel desk we already use.
expected_findings: Ordinary cost-sharing and a stated prior meeting should not alone trigger romance fraud; asserted context is not independently proven.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same supplier/listing invoice; control ties it to a purchase order and ordinary approval rather than demanding payment for unordered service.

messages.text: Invoice FI-101 from Bluefern Listings: pay LKR 9500 today for your mandatory directory entry, even if you never ordered it. Do not ask purchasing; late payment will shut your listing.
expected_findings: Unordered invoice demand plus bypass/pressure; source supports fake-invoice mechanism, not real debt validity.

messages.text: Invoice FI-101 from Bluefern Listings: LKR 9500 for the directory entry on purchase order PO-101. Please reconcile with purchasing and your existing supplier record before the normal payment run.
expected_findings: Invoice/amount alone not fraud; order and independent approval are meaningful control context, not authenticated proof.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Both mention new payee details; control holds payment pending independent supplier callback.

messages.text: Bluefern Supplies invoice FI-102 is due. Use our new beneficiary today and ignore the supplier record. Do not call your usual contact; that will delay dispatch.
expected_findings: Payment diversion/bypass hypothesis derived from invoice-verification principle; not a source-verified beneficiary incident.

messages.text: Bluefern Supplies invoice FI-102 is due. New beneficiary details require a hold until purchasing calls the usual contact from the existing supplier record. Do not pay on this email alone.
expected_findings: Payee change with independent hold is not automatically fraudulent; bypass instruction is absent.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same urgent printing invoice; control keeps urgency but follows normal reconciliation.

messages.text: Reedglass Print invoice FI-103: send LKR 12000 within the hour for posters you did not order. We cannot provide a purchase order; skip approval to avoid legal charges.
expected_findings: Unordered goods invoice and intimidation combined with approval bypass.

messages.text: Reedglass Print invoice FI-103: LKR 12000 for posters on PO-103. The payment run is within the hour; please reconcile delivery and obtain normal approval, or hold it for the next run.
expected_findings: Urgent payment run alone is not fraud; control permits delay and verification.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Both discuss hosting renewal; suspicious variant replaces ordinary billing with gift cards and bypasses the normal vendor.

messages.text: Starreed Hosting renewal FI-104: your site closes today unless you buy gift cards and email their codes to billing@starreed-pay.example. Do not use the normal billing portal.
expected_findings: Threatened renewal with gift-card payment demand and diversion from normal billing.

messages.text: Starreed Hosting renewal FI-104 is due today. Review it in the normal billing portal you already use. Billing will not accept gift-card codes by email; hold payment if the order does not match.
expected_findings: Renewal deadline and negated gift-card reference do not equal invoice fraud.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same management payment request; ordinary control permits independent approver review with existing vendor records.

messages.text: From the Cloudreed manager: settle invoice FI-105 to my private payment agent now. There is no order record; keep this outside accounts and do not contact the supplier.
expected_findings: Manager impersonation claim, missing order and secret payment diversion; message alone cannot verify identity.

messages.text: From the Cloudreed manager: review invoice FI-105 against the order record and supplier details already held by accounts. Please obtain the usual second approval before settlement, even if this waits until tomorrow.
expected_findings: Manager/invoice/payment words alone must not be overflagged; independent approval is control context.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same delivery-invoice dispute; control requests reconciliation, not a second transfer to an unverified agent.

messages.text: Silverfern Freight invoice FI-106 was lost. Pay it again to our new agent now; we will not send a duplicate invoice or confirm the delivery record. Do not involve purchasing.
expected_findings: Repeat-payment demand without records and blocked verification; derived invoice-check variant.

messages.text: Silverfern Freight invoice FI-106 appears missing from our ledger. Please reconcile your delivery and payment records with purchasing before any further payment; request a duplicate through the supplier contact already on file.
expected_findings: Missing invoice/second-payment discussion is not a demand to bypass checks.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Both discuss a supposedly free listing later billed; control treats unexpected invoice as a dispute instead of an obligation.

messages.text: Frostleaf Directory invoice FI-107: your free listing confirmation created a paid contract. Send LKR 8000 today even without a signed order; our collector will not accept questions.
expected_findings: Free-listing pretext followed by high-pressure invoice without order verification.

messages.text: Frostleaf Directory invoice FI-107 for LKR 8000 is disputed because the listing was described as free. Please hold payment and verify whether any signed order exists through the normal purchasing process.
expected_findings: Discussion of a suspicious invoice is not the same as issuing a fraudulent payment demand.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same invoice and supplier site; control includes actual ordinary payment subject to established records, not only a warning.

messages.text: Dawnreed Services invoice FI-108: pay the new wallet shown at https://dawnreed-pay.example/invoice before closing. Ignore your order amount and do not call the supplier to reconcile it.
expected_findings: Unreconciled new-payment destination and explicit verification bypass; .example itself is not malicious.

messages.text: Dawnreed Services invoice FI-108 is available at https://dawnreed-pay.example/invoice. If it matches the order and established supplier details, schedule the normal payment; otherwise call your existing supplier contact first.
expected_findings: A URL and conditional ordinary payment do not establish invoice fraud; independent reconciliation is necessary.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Both notify a prize winner; control has no fee and uses independently established contest details.

messages.text: You won the Mistfern draw: LKR 500000 awaits. Pay a LKR 5000 processing fee today to release your prize; you do not need to have entered.
expected_findings: Unexpected prize with required release fee, not a verified lottery win.

messages.text: Your entry won the Mistfern draw. Collection is free, with no processing fee; confirm through the contest desk on your original entry receipt before arranging collection.
expected_findings: Prize/processing-fee negation alone is not a scam demand; receipt context still needs independent verification.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same award collection topic; control removes financial credential disclosure.

messages.text: Sunreed award winner: reply with your bank login and password so we can deposit your prize. Your award expires if you ask the organizer to verify this request.
expected_findings: Prize-linked bank-credential collection and blocked verification.

messages.text: Sunreed award winner: no bank login or password is needed to collect your prize. Confirm the collection arrangements with the organizer through the contact on your original event programme.
expected_findings: Negated bank credential request should not become a positive finding solely from keywords.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Both mention a phone prize and delivery; control states no fee rather than changing the topic.

messages.text: Cloudpetal promotion: you won a phone. Transfer the delivery release charge to our private wallet within 20 minutes or your prize goes to someone else.
expected_findings: Prize delivery fee and urgency; message does not establish a real promotion.

messages.text: Cloudpetal promotion: your phone prize can be collected without any delivery release charge. Check the collection hours through the organizer details from the promotion you entered.
expected_findings: Prize/charge words are not enough; fee is expressly absent and verification remains needed.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same supposed lottery and customs paperwork; control discusses verification rather than paying an unverified collector.

messages.text: Ferncloud International Lottery selected your email. Pay the customs fee in gift cards to claim your cash award. Keep the codes private from your bank and send them only to our agent.
expected_findings: Unexpected lottery, prize-release fee and gift-card demand; no local legal inference.

messages.text: The Ferncloud International Lottery customs-fee message needs independent verification. Do not buy gift cards or send codes to its agent; we are reviewing the notice, not announcing a verified cash award.
expected_findings: A discussion/warning about a prize-fee scam is not itself a fee solicitation or verified winner.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Both discuss draw odds and entry; control keeps ordinary entry confirmation without payment to improve odds.

messages.text: Moonfern free draw update: pay our agent LKR 3000 to guarantee better winning odds today. Your existing free entry will be cancelled unless you buy this upgrade.
expected_findings: Payment to improve/retain a supposed free draw entry under pressure; do not assert Sri Lankan sweepstakes law.

messages.text: Moonfern free draw update: your existing entry remains valid with the same winning odds. No upgrade payment is requested; read the rules through the organiser details on your original entry form.
expected_findings: Free-entry/odds wording without fee demand is not enough for a scam finding.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same gift voucher notification with a URL; only suspicious version asks for card secrets.

messages.text: Rainpetal Stores voucher winner: enter your card number and security code at https://rainpetal-award.example/claim to unlock the gift. This is required even though the voucher is free.
expected_findings: Financial-secret collection to unlock a supposed prize; synthetic host is not reputation evidence.

messages.text: Rainpetal Stores voucher winner: public collection hours appear at https://rainpetal-award.example/claim. No card number or security code is needed; confirm through the store contact on your entry receipt.
expected_findings: Do not infer card collection from a negated warning or URL alone; no guarantee the message is genuine.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Both mention award paperwork and urgency; control is a normal nomination deadline, not a paid win.

messages.text: Ashfern Community Award: you are already the winner. Pay the award validation fee before tonight or lose the prize; no nomination or prior entry is necessary.
expected_findings: Unexpected assured award conditioned on validation payment and deadline.

messages.text: Ashfern Community Award nominations close tonight. Submitting nomination paperwork is free and does not mean you have won; confirm the process with the event committee you already know.
expected_findings: Award/deadline alone must not imply fee fraud; no win or secret collection asserted.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same prize collection and reservation topic; control uses free ordinary arrangements rather than a wallet deposit.

messages.text: Petalreed prize desk: reserve your winning bicycle by transferring LKR 4000 to this new wallet now. We cannot confirm your entry until the reservation fee arrives.
expected_findings: Prize collection conditional on unverified reservation payment.

messages.text: Petalreed prize desk: reserve a free collection time for your winning bicycle through the contact on your entry slip. No reservation fee is due; you may confirm your entry before arranging collection.
expected_findings: Ordinary collection/reservation words do not imply a payment scam; claimed win still requires verification.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same Colombo job/interview; suspicious version asks an upfront hiring fee. No invented job category.

messages.text: Fernpeak Jobs offers you a Colombo assistant role without an interview. Pay LKR 6000 registration today to secure the job; we cannot disclose the employer until you pay.
expected_findings: Upfront job-fee pattern; otherwise valid unsupported primary type should use unknown_other, not a new employment category.

messages.text: Fernpeak Jobs invites you to interview for a Colombo assistant role. No registration fee is payable by applicants; verify the employer and interview through the listing you applied to before sharing any documents.
expected_findings: Job/fee vocabulary is not itself a demand; unknown_other is not a safe verdict or authenticated employer claim.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same training and employment topic; control is an optional transparent course without a promised job.

messages.text: Cloudspire Hiring guarantees a work-from-home job after you pay our compulsory LKR 9000 training fee today. No interview or experience is needed; payment is the only requirement.
expected_findings: Compulsory upfront fee for guaranteed employment; unsupported category fallback without schema repair.

messages.text: Cloudspire Learning offers an optional LKR 9000 training course. It does not guarantee a work-from-home job and is not a hiring requirement; review the syllabus and cancellation terms independently before enrolling.
expected_findings: Paid optional education is not automatically a pay-for-job promise; no guarantee of vendor legitimacy either.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Both advertise home work and earnings; control retains a paid role with ordinary duties and no upfront demand.

messages.text: Reedspire Remote: earn LKR 200000 weekly for ten minutes of home work a day. Send a starter-kit deposit now to unlock guaranteed tasks; no employer details are available before payment.
expected_findings: Implausible easy earnings combined with upfront deposit and unverifiable employer; other-family category remains unknown_other if result valid.

messages.text: Reedspire Remote advertises a home-work bookkeeping role with scheduled weekly hours and salary discussed at interview. No starter-kit deposit is required; review duties and employer details through your original application.
expected_findings: Home-work salary language alone cannot establish a scam; no success or safety label forced.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same mystery-shopping certification; control requires ordinary interview, no paid certification.

messages.text: Rainspire Shopper hires you immediately if you pay for our job-guarantee certificate. Send LKR 7500 today; every applicant who pays is promised paid assignments tomorrow.
expected_findings: Pay-to-get mystery-shopping job/certificate; no named taxonomy family should be guessed.

messages.text: Rainspire Shopper will interview applicants before assigning paid visits. No job-guarantee certificate or applicant payment is required; review the written duties and expense process through the application channel you already used.
expected_findings: Negated certificate/payment warning is not an upfront fee demand; assess context, not isolated keywords.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same payroll cheque overpayment; control explicitly holds onward payment for independent correction.

messages.text: Petalspire Payroll sent your first cheque with extra equipment money. Deposit it and immediately send the surplus to our agent before the bank finishes its checks. Your job depends on doing this now.
expected_findings: Employer cheque followed by urgent onward transfer; unsupported fake-check job pattern uses unknown_other in otherwise valid result.

messages.text: Petalspire Payroll may have sent an incorrect cheque amount. Do not forward any surplus to an agent. Contact payroll through your existing employment record and your bank independently before arranging a documented correction.
expected_findings: Payroll correction discussion without onward-transfer demand is a contextual near-match, not automatic fake-check proof.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same new-assistant equipment purchase; control uses ordinary procurement instead of cheque-funded gift-card forwarding.

messages.text: Moonspire Assistants will send a cheque for your equipment. Keep your fee and buy gift cards for the rest, then email the codes to our supplier today. Do not ask procurement about this special arrangement.
expected_findings: Cheque-to-gift-card onward-payment and bypass pattern; no new category or verified incident count.

messages.text: Moonspire Assistants will arrange equipment through procurement after your employment is confirmed. Do not use a cheque to buy gift cards for a supplier; check the purchase order with your existing office contact.
expected_findings: Warning about cheque/gift cards is not solicitation; known-office assertion alone is not proof of trust.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Same staffing placement fee; control retains a genuine-looking agency context paid by employer instead of applicant.

messages.text: Dawnspire Staffing guarantees placement once you pay our advance fee. We will reveal the vacancy and employer only after transfer; do not compare this with other agencies.
expected_findings: Upfront placement promise without verifiable vacancy; otherwise valid unrepresented type uses unknown_other.

messages.text: Dawnspire Staffing lists the vacancy and employer for you to review before interview. Our placement fee is paid by the hiring company, not applicants; you may compare agencies and verify the listing independently.
expected_findings: Fee/placement keywords alone are not applicant-fee fraud; agency claims still need verification.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Both are ambiguous account/invoice reviews; control explicitly requires independent verification. Neither text supports a reliable primary category or a safety conclusion.

messages.text: Silverpetal desk: an account or invoice review may be needed. See https://silverpetal-review.example/info for details. This note does not identify the account, order or action requested.
expected_findings: Insufficient context: no invented credential/payment demand, category unknown_other only if result otherwise valid; no mismatch or reputation proof from the URL.

messages.text: Silverpetal desk: an account or invoice review may be needed. Do not act on https://silverpetal-review.example/info alone; verify the account and order through your existing desk contact before deciding whether anything is due.
expected_findings: Independent-verification wording must not be overflagged from account/invoice/URL keywords; ambiguity remains, not guaranteed legitimacy.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Both publish draw results at a URL; only the suspicious variant demands a claim/confirm action through the message link with no independent organizer contact.

messages.text: Pethfern draw winner: claim your LKR 750,000 prize at https://pethfern-claim.example/win within 48 hours.
expected_findings: Unexpected win claimed through a message-supplied link; no fee or credential needed for this evidence rule; link unverified, not proven malicious.

messages.text: Pethfern draw results are published at https://pethfern.example/results. Winners are notified by the organizer through the contact on your entry; no payment or details are needed to check.
expected_findings: A results URL without a claim demand is not a win-claim phishing pattern; notification path still needs independent verification.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Sinhala pair: both name the lottery and a results link; only the suspicious variant demands තහවුරු කරන්න through the message. ZWJ conjuncts (ජයග්‍රාහක, ත්‍යාග) pinned; no Sinhala accuracy claim.

messages.text: සුබ පැතුම්! ඔබ Pethfern ලොතරැයියේ ජයග්‍රාහකයෙක්. රු. 750,000 ත්‍යාගයක්. තහවුරු කරන්න: https://pethfern-claim.example/win
expected_findings: Sinhala win-claim with a message-supplied confirmation link; ZWJ conjunct spellings must match; no reputation or language-accuracy claim.

messages.text: Pethfern ලොතරැයි ප්‍රතිඵල https://pethfern.example/results හි පළවේ. ජයග්‍රාහකයන්ට දැනුම් දෙන්නේ ඔබේ ටිකට්පතේ සඳහන් නිල ක්‍රමවේදය අනුව ය; ගෙවීමක් අවශ්‍ය නොවේ.
expected_findings: A Sinhala results link without an imperative confirm demand must not fire; the negation guard stays English-only (documented asymmetry).

pairs.near_match_rationale: Adapted from the parcel-delivery-notice template family; the control keeps parcel/delivery vocabulary and a URL but states no customs fee is needed and no payment links are sent.

messages.text: Pethpost parcel notice: your parcel was unsuccessful as the courier attempted delivery. Pay the LKR 99 customs release fee at https://parcel-release.example/pay to get it today.
expected_findings: Failed-delivery pretext with a customs-release fee at a message-supplied link; amount and urgency mirror the reported template family.

messages.text: Pethpost parcels arrive at your local office; delivery hours are at https://pethpost.example/hours. No customs fee is needed for local parcels, and payment links are never sent by message.
expected_findings: The negation-guarded customs-fee cue must stay suppressed on the express no-fee control; informational URL alone is not evidence.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Adapted from the GovPay/traffic-fine phishing waves; the control keeps fine vocabulary but names counters/printed-notice verification, sends no link and does not demand payment.

messages.text: Pethway Motor Licensing: vehicle WP CAB-4412 has an unpaid traffic fine of LKR 5,500. Pay within 24 hours to avoid court action at https://govpay-fines.example/pay.
expected_findings: Fine payment under deadline pressure toward a message-supplied link; GovPay clone wording is engineering evidence, not a domain verdict.

messages.text: Pethway licensing queries: a traffic fine notice can be checked through the counters listed on the printed notice; payment links are not sent by message and you may dispute it before paying.
expected_findings: Fine vocabulary with independent counter verification and no message payment demand must not fire; no safety conclusion about the notice itself.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Adapted from the fake transfer-cancel SMS family; the control keeps transfer/alert wording but directs to the card's own number and forbids message links.

messages.text: Pethbank alert: a transfer is being made from your account. If this is not you, click the link below to cancel it now: https://pethbank-cancel.example/stop
expected_findings: Unauthorized-transfer pretext with a cancel-it-here destination; R-M4-01 may also fire (extra evidence is allowed on suspicious expectations).

messages.text: If a transfer shown in your banking app was not made by you, call the branch using the number on your card. Do not click links or cancel anything from a message.
expected_findings: A described-not-demanded unauthorized transfer with independent call-back guidance and no destination must stay silent.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Adapted from the doubling/Guaranteed-returns WhatsApp family (BOMate-type cases); the control retains fund-performance vocabulary behind an express risk disclosure, which suppresses the rule.

messages.text: Send LKR 100000 to our crypto desk today — your money is doubled every three months with guaranteed returns. Message our advisor on Telegram to start.
expected_findings: Doubling/guaranteed-return claim over an investment context; grooming first-contact texts without a doubling claim are deliberately not covered.

messages.text: Our long-term fund doubled in value over the last decade, but investments involve risk and past performance never guarantees returns; read the prospectus through the licensed regulator register before deciding.
expected_findings: The risk-disclosure suppressor must keep legitimate fund communication silent; suppression is not proof of legitimacy.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Shape-flag pair: the suspicious text combines a shortener and an abuse-TLD host with the parcel-fee demand; the control uses an informational .example URL, which fires no shape flag. Host spellings are fabricated and never fetched.

messages.text: Pethpost parcel held: pay the customs release fee at https://pethpost-release.top/pay within 24 hours. Details: bit.ly/pethpost-info
expected_findings: Shortener and abuse-TLD shape flags fire alongside the parcel-fee rule; a shape flag is engineering evidence, never a malicious-domain finding.

messages.text: Pethpost parcel delivery hours are listed at https://pethpost.example/hours. No customs fee is needed and payments are made only at the post office counter on your receipt.
expected_findings: An .example informational URL fires no shape flag and the negation-guarded fee cue stays suppressed.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Adapted from the charity/donation bank-details harvesting reports; the control keeps ask-for/provide vocabulary behind an express never warning.

messages.text: Hello, I am a doctor from overseas on charity work. I want to donate to your village; please provide your bank details so the funds reach you this week.
expected_findings: Unsolicited donation pretext soliciting bank details; covered by the extended secret vocabulary (bank details) and demand verbs.

messages.text: A charity caller asked for our village hall details. Never provide bank details in an unexpected call; verify the charity through its published contacts before any donation.
expected_findings: The described ask-for has no secret noun in its clause and the warned provide is negation-suppressed; disclosure-demand cues after a bare conditional stay suppressed.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Adapted from the .apk trojan-push reports; the control directs to the phone's official app store and attaches no file shape.

messages.text: Pethpost parcel held: install the delivery app Pethpost-verify.apk from https://pethpost-update.example/app to release your parcel today.
expected_findings: An .apk push is an engineering-acceptance shape flag; the .example URL itself fires nothing and is never fetched.

messages.text: Pethpost never sends apps by message. Install updates only from your phone's official app store, and no parcel release requires installing anything.
expected_findings: Official-store guidance with no attachment shape stays silent; no parcel-release fee cue is present.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Conservative Singlish starter pair (transliterated lottery/prize/do tokens); the control keeps the Singlish lottery token without a demand or destination. Low-corpus-evidence starter — documented as hypothesis only.

messages.text: Oba Pethfern lutharayi jayagrahakayek! Rs 500,000 prize ekai. Karanna: https://pethfern-claim.example/win
expected_findings: Transliterated win-claim with an imperative demand and a message link fires the same R-M4-13 hypothesis as the script variants.

messages.text: Pethfern lutharayi results are on the official site listed on your ticket. No money requests are made, and winners are notified through the entry contact.
expected_findings: A Singlish lottery mention without a demand or destination must stay silent; no Singlish coverage or accuracy claim follows.

pairs.near_match_rationale: Instant-loan family (added on owner direction after two reported scam texts; adapted synthetic wording — amounts and host changed). The control keeps loan and amount vocabulary but routes applications to branch/known app channels with no message link and no instant-approval promise.

messages.text: Rs. 250 000 dakwa Loan ekak labaganna puluwan. Obata avashya mudal sandaha danma apply karanna: https://k9f2.example/NkLX
expected_findings: Singlish instant-loan offer with an amount and a message-supplied link; matches the documented loans-lk.online/minicash-lk.com funnel family; link unverified, not proven malicious.

messages.text: Pethbank personal loans up to LKR 5,000,000 are applied for at your branch or through the banking app you already use. Approval is never instant, and no fee is collected before the loan is disbursed.
expected_findings: Loan and amount vocabulary with official-channel application guidance and no message link stays silent; a genuine lender promo that DOES include a link would fire (documented limitation — evidence, not verdict).

pairs.near_match_rationale: Singlish instant-money variant with no loan word at all (adapted synthetic wording) — pins the ikmanin instant-approval path; the control has no amount and no destination.

messages.text: Ikmanin LKR 300 000 bank account ekata https://m4x8.example/Tfdx1ih
expected_findings: Instant-money promise (ikmanin) with an amount, bank-account wording and an opaque message link; R-M4-20 must fire without any loan keyword.

messages.text: Salary credits reach your bank account on the normal pay date, and the bank never asks for details by message. Check any money offer through the branch listed on your card.
expected_findings: Bank-account wording without an amount or destination stays silent; no safety conclusion about the sender is implied.
